notes.title: Updated 202501201705_v1.1
notes.notes:
Thank the comrades for their long-term support, but also put forward a lot of useful suggestions for the game. Here to support the majority of our players to give high respect!
We also thank our comrades for their tolerance. In the New Year, we will develop and optimize the game content more quickly. We also hope that comrades can give us more valuable advice, in this our team offers sincere thanks!

What's New:
1. Updated the in-game visuals.
2. Some audio material has been updated.
3. Fixed some known bugs submitted by comrades and discovered by our own team during the testing process.
4. Fixed the controller modification button cannot be operated.
5. Optimized the visual effect of some UI.
6. Added new beginner levels.
7. Optimized the visual effects of some skill effects.
8. Optimized level difficulty and player health.
9. Add a scoring mechanism to give players the recognition of their strength.

notes.title: Demo version 202412112107 Updates:
notes.notes:
Demo version 202412112107 Updates:
1. Optimized the main city effect, changed the 2.5D view Angle to 2D view, increased the fireworks effect to enhance the New Year atmosphere, and optimized the scene dynamics and richness.
2. Add new sound effects.
3. The new player actively transforms, will remove the transform item in the item.
4. Fix abnormal damage after transformation.
5. Fixed the blood bar display bug, there is a problem that the health display does not match the actual health.
6. Fix gamepad key change problem. In the original design, the gamepad was disabled to change keys, but the previous version did not successfully disable this function. If players do have a need for gamepad change keys, we will decide whether to modify the design of this function based on questions and feedback.
7. Fix character bugs caused by player actions.
8. Fixed several issues found during development.
